game.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem
game.blurb: Story-driven stealth adventure following Amicia and Hugo far south to new regions and cities, from Asobo Studio, released 2022-10-17. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story: First Half

chapters.title: The Story: Second Half
chapters.summary: The last nine hidden story milestones, up to the end. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Flowers, Feathers, Chests and Souvenirs
chapters.summary: Finding every flower, feather and secret chest, and recalling every souvenir.

chapters.title: Upgrades and Skills
chapters.summary: Fully upgrading the sling, crossbow, gear, instruments and alchemy, and the Prudence, Aggressive and Opportunism skills.

chapters.title: Hidden Feats

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "A Plague Tale: Requiem" or "A Plague Tale Requiem". aplaguetale.fandom.com answers the API, with about 43 linked articles, mostly characters and places (such as "La Cuna"), plus "A Plague Tale: Requiem/Transcript"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1182900 is "A Plague Tale: Requiem". 23 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden. The first 17 in the Steam list have steadily falling unlock rates (83.6% down to 47.8%), so they read as story milestones; they were split into two halves at the gap after "A Sea of Promises" (54.8%), which is a guess from unlock rates, not from the data naming chapters. The other 6 hidden ones ("Night guard", "Alchemist", "Perfect shot", "Perfect throw", "Old protector", "Mercy") sit among the upgrade and skill achievements with rates of 9 to 60%; their goals are unknown, so they have their own chapter.
